acceptanceCriteria: The issue's static repro selects both specs, or reports a non-BOUNDED scope with a named unknown and no proven exclusion of the second spec.
A three-hop autoload chain is selected or reported as an unknown beyond a documented hop bound.
A namespaced constant and a custom inflection resolve the same way impact resolves them.
A spec referencing no constant that reaches the dirty file is still excluded with NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT.
--path, --base and --snapshot modes select the same as worktree mode for the same change.
Unknowns impact raises for the dirty set appear in the affected plan.
body: GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1475 (filed 2026-10-21). impact reports Ruby autoload-convention reverse references, but affected ignores them: a spec that reaches a changed class only through an autoloaded constant is excluded with NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT while plan.scope stays BOUNDED and unknown is empty. For Rails-style apps this under-selects silently. impact's dynamic-dispatch-unresolved unknown is also not carried into affected. Preferred fix: use the same autoload roots, inflections and ignore list as impact's ruby_autoload as transitive dependency edges; fallback: non-BOUNDED scope with RUBY_AUTOLOAD_REFERENCES_NOT_IN_GRAPH.
